{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Used to tell his pirates to take as many captives alive as they could. Not for ransom. For spacin'. Grim to say, but he liked to see 'em die.|[[Fenn Gilbrantes]], reminiscing about [[Clabburn the Elder]]|<ref name="Rough and Tundra">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325adv|text=Rough and Tundra|int=Rough and Tundra}}</ref>}}
'''Spacing''' was a form of execution where the condemned was placed in an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] without a space suit and sent into the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of space.

If a being was spaced while a ship was in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the body would disintegrate (its atoms would "cease to have any coherent meaning") once outside the ship's protective shield.
